description: Replace an always-allow stub with a token bucket that refills fractionally over elapsed time and caps at capacity
prompts: limiter.ts's TokenBucket.allow always returns true. Implement it properly: the constructor takes (capacity: number, refillRate: number) - `refillRate` tokens are added per second, capped at `capacity` tokens (never above it, even after a long idle period). allow(now: number): boolean refills the bucket based on elapsed seconds since the last call, then - if at least 1 token is available - consumes exactly 1 token and returns true; otherwise returns false and consumes nothing. The bucket starts full at construction time. The file must compile under tsc --strict.
name: add_ts_token_bucket_limiter

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit limiter.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build limiter.ts
node behavior_test.js
